caveats: HK PARITY V2 + SAFE STAKING V2 is research/shadow only, not production-approved.
The qualifying horse-selection thresholds were not changed for SAFE V2; SAFE V1 stakes were simply multiplied by 0.75.
Historical HKJC research/closing prices plus a 3% adverse-price stress are not the same as verified live accepted bookmaker prices.
The A$71.6k annual historical figure is not a forward income forecast; the calibrated model EV anchor is about A$14.9k/year.
The stored historical max drawdown is A$57k, but sequence stress is still materially larger; do not treat A$57k as a guaranteed maximum loss.
2026 is partial and must not be treated as a completed year.
Do not retune the frozen selection rule or SAFE V2 stakes after future wins or losses simply to preserve backtest appearance.
